mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Animation mode. "template": skeleton-based from template_animation_id (1 gen/direction; canvases over ~100px run in batches billed 1 each, up to one per clip frame at 256px). "skeleton-v3": the same template_animation_id posed onto the character, which moves the character instead of redrawing it each frame — steadier identity and colours, 2-4 generations and ~3-5 min per direction, beta. Without template_animation_id, "skeleton-v3" animates action_description instead: the action is written into one 3D motion (3-15 frames, ~15 s before the jobs start) that every direction of the animation is drawn from, so directions added later with animation_group_id move the same way (humanoid characters). "v3": custom animation from action_description with frame_count control. "pixminimax": custom animation from action_description on PixMiniMax (beta) — up to 40 frames at any size, priced by size and frame count (64x64 at 8 frames = 1 generation, 40 frames = 6), ~1-7 min per direction. "pro" (legacy, prefer v3 or pixminimax): custom animation that generates directions sequentially, using completed sides as reference (10-25 gen/direction). Auto-detected: template if template_animation_id is provided, v3 otherwise.

action_description.title: Action Description
action_description.description: Action description (e.g., 'walking', 'running', 'jumping'). Required for custom mode (when template_animation_id is omitted). For template mode, defaults to a description based on the template.

frame_count.title: Frame Count
frame_count.description: Number of animation frames. v3 mode: 4-16, even. pixminimax mode: a multiple of 4 from 4 to 40. skeleton-v3 with action_description: 3-15 (a later direction of the same animation keeps the animation's own count). Not used in other modes.

directions.title: Directions
directions.description: List of directions to animate (south, north, east, west, etc.). Template mode: defaults to all character directions. Custom mode: defaults to south only.

animation_group_id.title: Animation Group Id
animation_group_id.description: Pass the animation_group_id of an existing animation on this character to add more directions to it. Omit to create a new animation; the new animation_group_id is returned so subsequent calls can extend it. Same semantics as animate_object. A direction the group already has is rejected with 409: delete it first, or omit the id to create a new animation.

background_job_ids.title: Background Job Ids
background_job_ids.description: List of background job IDs (one per direction)

animation_group_id.title: Animation Group Id
animation_group_id.description: The group these directions belong to. Pass it back on a later call to add more directions to the same animation.

enhanced_prompt.title: Enhanced Prompt
enhanced_prompt.description: The expanded motion description used for generation. Populated only when enhance_prompt=true (mode='v3').

enhance_usage.description: Cost of the prompt enhancement, separate from generation usage. Populated only when enhance_prompt=true.

responseSchema.title: CreateCharacterAnimationResponse
responseSchema.description: Response model for character animation (background jobs)

limits: Documentation establishes availability, not output quality or a measured animation pivot.
paste_x/paste_y are not a documented managed-animation alignment contract.
